verdict.rationale: Paperspace ships an official CLI (Gradient/pspace) documented for creating machines, managing API keys, and programmatic resource management, confirmed by docs and a dedicated reference page. However, evidence doesn't show CLI support tailored for agentic/AI-native workflows (e.g., scripting for autonomous agents, MCP integration, or CI/agent pipelines) — missing for 10: agent-oriented CLI use cases, independent hands-on validation of CLI reliability, and evidence of AI-native workflow integration beyond basic machine/resource management.
